As a Staff Machine Learning Platform Engineer, you'll own core parts of that platform. That means extracting maximum utilization from large GPU fleets, moving models from experiment to production without a rewrite, and serving inference at low latency and high throughput under real traffic. You set technical direction rather than take tickets, and the architecture you define shapes how hundreds of engineers across Adobe train and ship AI.
